stylePrompt: Mature learner-facing educational illustration, landscape 3:2, one clear focal meaning, varied painterly or naturalist styles, no photographic or live-action impression, no in-image teaching text, logos or watermarks. Every readable face has natural features and complete hands. Avoid blank faces, chibi proportions, glossy toy rendering, realistic skin pores, stock-photo staging and readable interfaces. Exactly six declared items integrate specific Chinese cultural settings with material and activity accuracy, without generic decorative symbolism or visual stereotypes.

items.meaningZh: 有责任的；负责的；责任重大的
items.sentenceEn: The responsible mechanic checks the bicycle brakes twice before returning it.
items.sentenceZh: 负责任的技师在归还自行车前两次检查刹车。
items.scene: One adult bicycle mechanic carefully tests both front and rear brakes on a repaired bicycle before handing it back to the waiting customer, showing thorough responsibility and safe professional care.
items.altText: 一名技师在归还修好的自行车前仔细检查前后刹车。

items.sentenceEn: The committee meets to manage the neighborhood's affairs.
items.sentenceZh: 委员会开会处理社区事务。
items.scene: Exactly four adult neighbors meet around one table to manage several community affairs represented by small physical models of a playground, bus shelter, garden and repair tools, with one model assigned to each person for organized action.
items.altText: 四名社区成员围桌讨论游乐场、公交亭、花园和维修等事务。

items.sentenceEn: The tea master follows a careful procedure to brew the tea.
items.sentenceZh: 茶艺师按照细致步骤冲泡茶叶。
items.scene: One continuous flowing scene repeats the same adult Chinese tea master through exactly four ordered stages of gongfu tea brewing: warming the clay teapot, adding loose leaves, pouring hot water and serving evenly into small cups, with the same tea tray connecting the sequence.
items.altText: 同一名茶艺师依次温壶、投茶、注水并把茶汤均匀倒入小杯。

items.meaningZh: 规律的；定期的；常规的；普通的
items.sentenceEn: The garden window has a regular repeating pattern.
items.sentenceZh: 园林漏窗有规则重复的图案。
items.scene: A close architectural view in a Suzhou classical garden centers one white plaster lattice window whose identical geometric openings repeat at perfectly even spacing, framed by gray tiles, bamboo and weathered stone.
items.altText: 苏州园林白墙上的漏窗由间距均匀的相同几何纹样重复组成。

items.sentenceEn: She spreads the folding fan open with both hands.
items.sentenceZh: 她用双手把折扇展开。
items.scene: One adult Chinese craft demonstrator uses both hands to spread one traditional bamboo-and-paper folding fan from a compact folded bundle into a broad semicircle, with the ribs visibly radiating outward during the opening action.
items.altText: 一名工艺演示者用双手把竹骨纸折扇展开成宽阔半圆。

items.sentenceEn: The chairman guides the cooperative's monthly meeting.
items.sentenceZh: 主席主持合作社的月度会议。
items.scene: Exactly five adults sit around one oval table at an agricultural cooperative meeting; the chairman occupies the clearly designated head position, calmly guides the discussion with an open-hand gesture and gives equal attention to the other four members.
items.altText: 合作社会议中，主席坐在主位引导另外四名成员讨论。

items.sentenceEn: The batter hits the baseball toward the open field.
items.sentenceZh: 击球手把棒球击向开阔球场。
items.scene: At a safe community baseball field, one adult batter has just struck one white baseball with a wooden bat; the ball is visibly leaving the bat toward the open outfield while one helmeted catcher remains behind the plate.
items.altText: 棒球场上，击球手刚用木棒击中白色棒球，球正飞向外场。

items.meaningZh: 软的；温和的；柔和的；柔滑的；温柔的
items.sentenceEn: The Suzhou silk feels soft against her hand.
items.sentenceZh: 苏州丝绸触碰手掌时感觉柔软。
items.scene: One adult Chinese silk craftsperson drapes a wide length of plain Suzhou silk across one open palm; the fabric falls in extremely smooth gentle folds and responds to the lightest touch, with a wooden handloom softly visible behind.
items.altText: 苏州丝绸工艺师把光滑丝绸搭在掌心，布料形成柔和细腻的褶皱。

items.sentenceEn: The sleepy dog ignores the ball and keeps resting.
items.sentenceZh: 困倦的狗无视皮球，继续休息。
items.scene: One sleepy adult dog lies comfortably with its head deliberately turned away from one bright ball placed directly beside its front paws, keeping its eyes closed and clearly ignoring the invitation to play.
items.altText: 一只困倦的狗把头转离爪边的鲜艳皮球，闭眼继续休息。

items.sentenceEn: One fresh egg rests safely in the straw nest.
items.sentenceZh: 一枚新鲜鸡蛋安稳地放在稻草窝里。
items.scene: Exactly one clean brown chicken egg rests intact in the center of a simple straw nest, fully visible in close view, with one adult hen standing calmly nearby but no other eggs or egg-shaped objects.
items.altText: 一个稻草窝中央只有一枚完整的棕色鸡蛋，旁边站着一只母鸡。

items.sentenceEn: Her belief that the forest can recover keeps her planting trees.
items.sentenceZh: 她相信森林能够恢复，因此坚持植树。
items.scene: One adult conservationist plants a healthy young native tree at the edge of a damaged hillside while a continuous background transition shows earlier plantings growing into a recovering green forest, making her guiding belief visible through sustained action and result.
items.altText: 一名保护工作者在受损山坡栽下幼树，身后早先种植的树已逐渐形成森林。

items.sentenceEn: The instructor demonstrates how a magnet attracts iron nails.
items.sentenceZh: 老师演示磁铁如何吸引铁钉。
items.scene: Exactly three adults gather at a science bench: one instructor deliberately holds one horseshoe magnet above several plain iron nails that lift visibly toward it, while exactly two learners watch the demonstrated effect closely.
items.altText: 老师把马蹄形磁铁悬在铁钉上方，向两名学员演示铁钉被吸起。

items.sentenceEn: She opens the workshop door to see whether anybody is inside.
items.sentenceZh: 她打开工作室门，看看里面是否有人。
items.scene: One adult opens a workshop door and looks carefully into a fully visible empty room containing workbenches and tools but no other person anywhere, making the search for any possible person clear.
items.altText: 一名成年人打开工作室门查看，室内工作台之间没有任何人。

items.sentenceEn: The detectives investigate the murder without disturbing the scene.
items.sentenceZh: 侦探在不破坏现场的情况下调查谋杀案。
items.scene: Exactly two adult detectives soberly examine a sealed indoor crime scene from behind a plain barrier: a fully covered human form lies behind a privacy screen while an overturned chair and one dropped glove suggest a fatal crime, with no body detail, blood or weapon visible.
items.altText: 两名侦探隔着封锁带查看现场，隐私屏后的人体被完全覆盖，没有血迹或武器。

items.sentenceEn: She brings fine tea as a gift for her host.
items.sentenceZh: 她带来好茶作为送给主人家的礼物。
items.scene: Exactly two Chinese adults meet at a home entrance as one guest presents a single elegant tea tin wrapped in plain red cloth with both hands and the host receives it warmly with both hands, expressing respectful Chinese gift-giving etiquette.
items.altText: 住宅门口，客人用双手送上红布包裹的茶礼，主人也用双手接过。

items.sentenceEn: People express religion through different forms of prayer and worship.
items.sentenceZh: 人们通过不同形式的祈祷和礼拜表达宗教信仰。
items.scene: A respectful connected triptych shows three separate adult worshippers in distinct quiet spaces: one kneels on a plain prayer rug, one sits in silent meditation before a simple lamp and one stands with hands joined beside a candle, emphasizing varied religious practice without merging traditions.
items.altText: 三名成年人分别在独立安静空间中以跪祷、静坐和合手等方式进行宗教活动。

items.sentenceEn: The engineers review the bridge model before approving construction.
items.sentenceZh: 工程师在批准施工前评审桥梁模型。
items.scene: Exactly three adult engineers pause around one detailed bridge model, carefully inspect the supports, deck and river clearance from different angles and compare physical test pieces before any construction begins.
items.altText: 三名工程师从不同角度检查桥梁模型的支撑、桥面和河道净空。

items.sentenceEn: The editor checks every page before the newspaper is printed.
items.sentenceZh: 报纸印刷前，编辑检查每一个版面。
items.scene: One adult editor examines several large newspaper proof pages spread across a light table, uses a pencil to mark one layout correction and compares image blocks and headlines represented only by intentionally unreadable gray shapes.
items.altText: 一名编辑在灯桌上检查报纸校样，并用铅笔标出一处版面修改。

items.sentenceEn: The mechanical puzzle engages all three participants.
items.sentenceZh: 机械谜题吸引三名参与者全神贯注地投入。
items.scene: Exactly three adults lean actively around one large tabletop mechanical puzzle, each turning a different connected wooden gear while watching the shared mechanism respond, with focused faces and full participation from all three.
items.altText: 三名成年人围着机械谜题转动相连木齿轮，全部专注投入其中。

items.sentenceEn: The Yunnan farmer brews coffee from beans grown on her hillside farm.
items.sentenceZh: 云南农户用自家山地种植的咖啡豆冲泡咖啡。
items.scene: One adult Chinese coffee farmer in Yunnan pours a fragrant dark cup beside a tray of freshly roasted beans, while ripe red coffee cherries and shaded hillside coffee plants behind her clearly connect crop, beans and drink.
items.altText: 云南咖啡农在烘焙豆和红色咖啡果旁冲泡一杯深色咖啡。
